text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower takes her first step as a<n>racer and
makes her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, she watches one of<n>Mihono
Bourbon's races, who,<n>despite debuting in the
same year, is<n>already drawing a lot of attention.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her bring smiles to so many<n>people's faces
inspires Rice Shower<n>to run in the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With the goal of catching up to<n>Mihono Bourbon set
firmly in her<n>mind... she decides to run in the<n>Spring
Stakes as a warm-up for the<n>Triple Crown.
